decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line is a multi-model line with its own page that fits the firm's core certified natural skincare offer, so after two years it is likely an established part of the assortment worth keeping.
A cleansing milk is a basic staple of facial care that complements the other lines and is cheap to keep producing in small batches, even though the hyaluronic serum was dropped.
The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and extends the cleansing range in a way that suits natural skincare customers, so a small firm would give it more time to prove itself.
